HOW IT WORKS

Your words.
A considered route.

You don’t need a perfect prompt. Start with what you want to achieve.

01

Tell us the outcome

Write naturally. Simple local rules identify writing, reasoning, coding, images, finance, research, and legal questions.

02

Give the choice some direction

Auto ranks enabled models using illustrative task profiles and your priorities. A manual choice still respects your text-cost budget.

03

See the choice explained

Open “Explain the route” below a response to see estimated tokens, cost, modeled time, and alternatives.

04

Make it yours

Explore conversations and different priorities. Chats stay in this tab unless you opt into saving on your device.
